metadata.description: First-party Claude-format plugins published as individually installable skills and hooks.

plugins.name: project-advisor
plugins.description: Project planning skills for recommending what to build next, writing PRDs, and turning approved PRDs into Jira-ready work items or coding-agent task files.

plugins.name: refactor-tools
plugins.description: Refactoring, cleanup, and review skills for safe, behavior-preserving code improvements.

plugins.name: task-executor
plugins.description: Implements coding-agent task files with TDD, requirement verification, and independent review-fix loops.

plugins.name: agent-hooks
plugins.description: Claude-format hook that denies environment dumps and asks for approval before tools access common credential files.
